summary: A better option may appear the moment you stop trying to make the old one work.
body: A better option may appear the moment you stop trying to make the old one work. When the Sun sextiles Uranus, confidence and experimentation support each other, making it easier to change the method without losing the larger goal. A new tool, unexpected invitation, different schedule, or sudden idea could solve something you have been forcing for too long. Follow the opening that gives you more freedom without creating another problem you will have to clean up later.
